facts.fact: PPRA Director General Dennis Simba told Parliament's Public Accounts Committee that the National e-Procurement System of Tanzania (NeST) now comprises six modules: e-registration, e-tendering, e-contract management, e-complaints, e-auction and e-payment.

Dennis Simba of PPRA said that through the e-payment module procuring entities can conduct the entire procurement process within NeST up to and including payment, with integration to government payment platforms done and the budget-system link being finalised.

TZA.note: Document states nothing on the central bank.
Document states nothing on digital finance consumer rules.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document mentions a 30% procurement allocation for special groups, which is not digital accessibility.
Document concerns payments to tenderers, not to people.
Document states nothing on mobile money.
Document states nothing on tax or fee payment.
